name: Saloon
definition: passenger car with a separate boot behind a fixed roof over two rows of seats.

name: Hatchback
definition: passenger car whose rear door is a top-hinged tailgate opening onto the load space.

name: Estate
definition: passenger car with the roof carried back to the rear and a tailgate over a long load space.

name: Coupé
definition: closed passenger car with a fixed roof, two doors and a sloping rear.

name: Convertible
definition: passenger car whose roof folds or comes off.

name: SUV
definition: passenger car with a tall body, raised ground clearance and often four-wheel drive.

name: MPV
definition: passenger car with a tall one-box body and up to three rows of seats where the load space would be.

name: Microcar
definition: light enclosed four-wheeled car below the ordinary car class, sold as its own category.

name: Panel van
definition: goods vehicle with an enclosed windowless load box behind the cab.

name: Pickup truck
definition: light goods vehicle with a cab and an open load bed.

name: Rigid truck
definition: truck built on one chassis with its body fitted (box, dropside, tipper).

name: Tractor unit
definition: truck made to tow a semi-trailer on a fifth-wheel coupling.

name: Minibus
definition: passenger vehicle with four or more rows of seats, below bus size.

name: Limousine
definition: long-wheelbase chauffeur-driven car with a partition or extended rear passenger compartment.

name: Window van
definition: van with side windows and seats or space for passengers and goods.

name: Bus or coach
definition: large passenger vehicle for many seated or standing passengers.

name: Standard motorcycle
definition: general-purpose motorcycle with an upright riding position and little or no fairing.

name: Cruiser motorcycle
definition: low-seated motorcycle with feet-forward controls and a laid-back riding position.

name: Sport motorcycle
definition: motorcycle built for speed and handling, with a forward-leaning position and full fairing.

name: Touring motorcycle
definition: large motorcycle made for long distances, with wind protection, luggage and passenger comfort.

name: Adventure motorcycle
definition: motorcycle made for both road and unpaved riding, with long suspension travel.

name: Moped
definition: light low-powered two-wheeler with a small engine or motor and no working pedal drive.

name: Scooter
definition: motor scooter with a step-through frame, floorboard and small wheels.

name: Electric kick scooter
definition: stand-up scooter with an electric motor, made to carry a rider from place to place.

name: Motorcycle with sidecar
definition: motorcycle sold with a one-wheeled passenger car attached at the side.

name: Electric unicycle
definition: one-wheeled self-balancing electric vehicle ridden standing.

name: Powered skateboard
definition: skateboard with an electric motor, made to carry a rider from place to place.

name: Off-road motorcycle
definition: motorcycle made for off-road riding or off-road sport.

name: Trike
definition: three-wheeled motorcycle.

name: Hoverboard
definition: two-wheeled self-balancing electric board ridden standing.

name: Quad bike
definition: four-wheeled straddle-seat all-terrain vehicle with handlebars, off-road or road-registered.

name: Snowmobile
definition: tracked vehicle with front skis made to travel over snow.

name: Side-by-side
definition: off-road utility vehicle with side-by-side seats and a steering wheel.

name: Golf cart
definition: small low-speed vehicle made to carry players and their bags over a golf course.

name: Go-kart
definition: small open single-seat four-wheeled vehicle with a low chassis.

name: Dune buggy
definition: light open off-road car made for sand and rough ground.

name: Mini bike
definition: scaled-down motorcycle with small wheels and a small engine.

name: Gravel bike
definition: Drop-bar bicycle with wide tyre clearance, made for mixed paved and unpaved roads.

name: Cross-country mountain bike
definition: light mountain bike with short suspension travel made for climbing and fast off-road riding.

name: Downhill mountain bike
definition: mountain bike with long-travel full suspension made for steep descents.

name: City bike
definition: upright everyday bicycle for town riding, usually with mudguards and a chain guard.

name: Mini-velo
definition: non-folding bicycle with small wheels and a full-size frame fit.

name: Cargo bike
definition: bicycle built to carry loads or passengers on a platform, box or extended rear.

name: Trail mountain bike
definition: mid-travel mountain bike made for all-round trail riding.

name: Enduro mountain bike
definition: long-travel mountain bike made for timed descents and the climbs between them.

name: Dirt-jump mountain bike
definition: small hardtail mountain bike made for jumps and pump tracks.

name: Track bike
definition: fixed-gear bicycle without brakes made for velodrome racing.

name: Time-trial bike
definition: aerodynamic road bicycle with aero bars made for racing against the clock.

name: Hybrid bike
definition: flat-bar bicycle mixing road and mountain-bike features for general riding.

name: Road bike
definition: drop-bar bicycle made for speed on paved roads.

name: BMX bike
definition: small-wheeled single-speed bicycle made for racing, tricks and park riding.

name: Folding bike
definition: bicycle whose frame folds to a compact size for carrying or storage.

name: Cyclocross bike
definition: drop-bar bicycle made for cyclocross racing on mixed off-road courses.

name: Touring bike
definition: sturdy bicycle made to carry luggage on long rides.

name: Fat bike
definition: bicycle with oversized tyres made for snow and sand.

name: Adult tricycle
definition: three-wheeled pedal cycle made for an adult rider.

name: Recumbent bicycle
definition: bicycle ridden in a reclined seat with the pedals in front.

name: Tandem
definition: bicycle made for two or more riders pedalling one behind the other.

name: Handcycle
definition: cycle driven by the arms through hand cranks.

name: Velomobile
definition: recumbent cycle enclosed in an aerodynamic body shell.

name: Cycle rickshaw
definition: pedal tricycle made to carry paying passengers or goods.

name: Boat trailer
definition: towed trailer made to carry, launch and recover a boat.

name: Horsebox
definition: towed trailer made to carry horses.

name: Car transporter trailer
definition: towed trailer made to carry one or more cars.

name: Tipper trailer
definition: towed goods trailer whose body tips to unload.

name: Touring caravan
definition: towed living trailer with a fixed body.

name: Fifth-wheel caravan
definition: towed living trailer whose raised front rides over a pickup bed on a fifth-wheel hitch.

name: Truck camper
definition: living body made only to be carried in a pickup bed.

name: Campervan
definition: van converted for living and sleeping, keeping the van body.

name: A-class motorhome
definition: motorhome whose body is built over a bare chassis with its own integrated cab.

name: Box trailer
definition: towed trailer with an open or closed box for goods.

name: Motorcycle trailer
definition: towed trailer made to carry motorcycles.

name: Bicycle trailer
definition: trailer towed by a bicycle, for a child, a dog or goods.

name: Folding camper
definition: towed camper whose walls and roof fold down for travel.

name: Low-profile motorhome
definition: coachbuilt motorhome with a low roofline and no over-cab bed.

name: Overcab motorhome
definition: coachbuilt motorhome with a sleeping area over the driving cab.

name: Expandable-end trailer
definition: towed living trailer with fold-out tent ends over a hard body.

name: Sport utility RV
definition: towed or driven RV with a built-in garage for carrying vehicles or gear.

name: Special-purpose body vehicle
definition: vehicle with a body made for one service, such as a fire engine, ambulance or hearse.

name: Horse-drawn carriage
definition: wheeled passenger vehicle drawn by horses.

name: Horse-drawn wagon
definition: wheeled goods vehicle drawn by an animal.

name: Sleigh
definition: Vehicle on runners, pulled by an animal or machine, that carries people or goods over snow.

name: Pram
definition: wheeled baby carriage whose only body is a lying carrycot, pushed by hand.

name: Stroller
definition: Wheeled seat for a baby or child, pushed by hand; includes a frame sold with a carrycot and seat unit.

name: Jogging stroller
definition: three-wheeled stroller made to be pushed while running.

name: Double stroller
definition: stroller seating two children side by side or one behind the other.

name: Pet stroller
definition: Wheeled carrier made to push a pet.

name: Locomotive
definition: rail vehicle that provides the power to haul a train.

name: Railway carriage or wagon
definition: unpowered rail vehicle for passengers or goods.

name: Handcar
definition: small rail vehicle moved by its riders' muscle (pumped or pedalled).

name: Railcar
definition: self-propelled rail vehicle carrying passengers.

name: Tram
definition: rail vehicle running on street track to carry passengers.

name: Motor trolley
definition: small motorised rail vehicle for track inspection or maintenance crews.

name: Kayak
definition: Narrow paddle craft driven by a double-bladed paddle, rigid or inflatable.

name: Canoe
definition: open paddle craft driven by a single-bladed paddle.

name: Rowing boat
definition: small boat driven by oars.

name: Rowing shell
definition: long narrow racing boat rowed with oars on sliding seats.

name: Pedal boat
definition: small boat driven by pedals turning a paddle wheel or propeller.

name: Sailing dinghy
definition: small open sailing monohull with a centreboard.

name: Open keelboat
definition: sailing monohull with a ballast keel and no or minimal cabin.

name: Cruising monohull
definition: sailing monohull with accommodation for living aboard.

name: Beach catamaran
definition: open sailing multihull launched from a beach.

name: Cruising multihull
definition: Sailing catamaran or trimaran with accommodation.

name: Motorsailer
definition: Sailing craft with an engine strong enough to cruise under power as well as sail.

name: Racer-cruiser
definition: sailing yacht with accommodation, made to both race and cruise.

name: Gulet
definition: traditional wooden two- or three-masted motor-sailing yacht for charter cruising.

name: Bowrider
definition: open powerboat with seating in the bow ahead of the helm.

name: Centre console boat
definition: open powerboat with the helm on a console in the middle of the deck.

name: Cabin cruiser
definition: powerboat with an enclosed cabin for overnight use.

name: Rigid inflatable boat
definition: powerboat with a rigid hull and inflatable tubes.

name: Personal watercraft
definition: small sit-on or stand-up jet-driven craft ridden like a motorcycle.

name: Houseboat
definition: Hull with its own engine and steering, made to be lived aboard and navigated.

name: Trawler
definition: displacement motor yacht with a trawler-style hull made for economical long-range cruising.

name: Motor yacht
definition: large powerboat with accommodation for cruising.

name: Sport-fishing boat
definition: powerboat made for offshore fishing.

name: Pontoon boat
definition: flat-decked powerboat on two or more pontoons.

name: Jon boat
definition: flat-bottomed small powerboat for shallow water.

name: Jet boat
definition: powerboat driven by a water jet.

name: Tender
definition: small boat made to carry people and goods between a larger vessel and the shore.

name: eFoil
definition: Electric hydrofoil board ridden standing.

name: Single-engine piston airplane
definition: fixed-wing airplane with one piston engine.

name: Turboprop airplane
definition: fixed-wing airplane driven by one or more turboprop engines.

name: Multi-engine piston airplane
definition: fixed-wing airplane with two or more piston engines.

name: Jet
definition: fixed-wing airplane driven by jet engines, from light and business jets to airliners.

name: Floatplane
definition: fixed-wing airplane made to take off from and land on water.

name: Glider
definition: unpowered fixed-wing aircraft that flies by soaring.

name: Motor-glider
definition: glider with an engine for take-off or sustaining flight.

name: Helicopter
definition: rotorcraft lifted and driven by powered rotors.

name: Gyroplane
definition: rotorcraft with an unpowered rotor and a separate propeller.

name: Hot-air balloon
definition: lighter-than-air aircraft lifted by heated air in an envelope.

name: Gas balloon
definition: lighter-than-air aircraft lifted by a light gas, without propulsion.

name: Airship
definition: powered, steerable lighter-than-air aircraft.

name: Powered parachute
definition: aircraft with a parachute wing and a motorised cart below it.

name: Weight-shift trike
definition: powered hang-glider-type wing over a trike, steered by shifting weight.

name: Trailer bike
definition: one-wheeled half bicycle with saddle, bars and pedals, hitched to an adult bicycle so a child can ride and pedal behind.

name: Performance powerboat
definition: open or cuddy powerboat with a deep-V or stepped hull and high power, made for speed.

name: Bass boat
definition: low, flat-decked freshwater fishing boat with raised casting decks, livewells and a high-power outboard.

name: Ski and wakeboard boat
definition: inboard powerboat built to tow water-skiers or wakeboarders, with a tow pylon or tower and a tuned wake.

name: Deck boat
definition: open powerboat with a wide beam carried forward to a large open bow deck, seating many on a V or tri-hull.

name: Recumbent tricycle
definition: three-wheeled pedal cycle ridden in a reclined seat with the pedals in front (tadpole or delta layout).

name: Teardrop trailer
definition: small towed living trailer with a teardrop profile, a sleeping cabin and a rear-hatch galley, without standing room inside.

name: Stroller wagon
definition: wheeled box-bodied carrier with harnessed seats for two or more children, pushed like a stroller or pulled by a handle.

name: Flats boat
definition: shallow-draft open saltwater fishing boat with a poling or casting platform, made for bays and tidal flats.

name: River raft
definition: inflatable open boat of large tubes, paddled or rowed by a group, made for whitewater rivers.

name: Paramotor
definition: backpack engine and propeller worn by a foot-launched pilot under a paraglider wing.
